Grundy Domination of Graph Products and Minimum Rank (v3.0.0).

The paper (`GrundyPaper.pdf`, 26 pages) proves the rank bound for strong and direct products,
determines the Grundy domination number of strong tori and of further product families, shows
that both product conjectures of Brešar et al. are false with unbounded ratios, and answers
Question 1 of Brešar, Henning and Rall negatively with projective planes. The repository holds
the Lean 4 certificate (`lean/`) and the Julia checks (`julia/`).
